m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: It is an honor to meet you. I saw Tse-Tse skulking about the city. I trailed him to his hut.
If you hurry, you can catch him there!
<ITALICS>The door was locked earlier, but it's open now. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>After defeating the bug, you see there's someone in the shadows. A student from Wizard City! Tied up! </ITALICS>
Tse-Tse captured me right before I got to Zamunda. He snuck me in and said he was keeping me for his dark queen!
Tse-Tse just left. He said he was going to the Tomb of the Zebra Kings. Sounds awful! Thanks for saving me! I'm outta here!
Tse-Tse is going to the Tomb of the Zebra Kings? You must stop him!
While you were dealing with the upstart Impi Raiders, my daughter Mandisa was keeping an eye out for Tse-Tse.
Quick, go and talk to Princess Mandisa Autumnrain and find out what she saw. Then track Tse-Tse down and bring him here!
Hurry, ask Princess Mandisa what she saw. Then go after Tse-Tse and capture him!
